name: EM Wave Explorer
description: Freely explore how an oscillating electron on a transmitting antenna generates propagating electromagnetic waves. Adjust frequency and amplitude; observe the retarded field at distance.

successCriteria.description: Notice the red curve connecting field arrow tips propagates outward
Observe field arrows changing direction as the wave passes

hints.message: Drag Frequency slider to change how fast the electron oscillates
The red curve shows the wave envelope; green arrows show field strength at each point
